## What's new

- Added Danish translation, Danish can now be selected in the language settings
- Ticked checkboxes are now hidden in the list when completed tasks are hidden
- Ticked checkboxes are now shown after open ones in the detail view

### Fixes

- Fixed a blank entry being left behind when changing the collection of a new entry
- Fixed the detail view opening scrolled past the collection selector
- Fixed the checkbox being pushed off-screen in the list view for tasks without summary
- Fixed sorting within groups when grouping by category or resource: the secondary sort order is now applied correctly (#2408)
- Fixed the color picker taking up the full width so that the surrounding area could no longer be scrolled

### Other

- Updated translations
- Library and stability updates
